cases.prompt: Capture a complete multi-page export containing code, emoji, and an image over a wide background.
assertions: Reconcile all message IDs and order against the PDF.
Verify the background reaches all four edges with uniform scaling and continuous seams.
cases.grader: Compare source manifest, extracted text and every page raster.

cases.prompt: Capture ordered screenshots with an unavailable attachment.
assertions: Label source completeness unverified and account for the unavailable attachment.
Preserve the screenshots alongside reviewed transcription.
cases.grader: Inspect the PDF, source inventory and delivery notes.
